versions.content: Allowed CanFrame . frameLength settings For a CanFrame it is allowed to configure a smaller frameLength than the length of the Pdu which is mapped to this CanFrame . This is used to model the minimum length of the received L-PDU of a CanFrame to be accepted, if the data length check is enabled.
